item.text: {"iteration":3,"pcvs":[{"name":"waiting_requests","expression":"len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting)","rationale":"Admission costs for batches of three through eight requests are approximately linear in queue size."},{"name":"single_waiting_request","expression":"int(len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting) == 1)","rationale":"Captures the observed excess cost of the singleton admission state."},{"name":"two_waiting_requests","expression":"int(len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting) == 2)","rationale":"Captures the separate excess cost observed for the two-request admission state."},{"name":"running_with_empty_waiting","expression":"len(self.running) if len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting) == 0 else 0","rationale":"Distinguishes empty-queue entries by live batch size to test whether their instruction variation follows scheduler state."}],"hypothesis":"Larger admission batches follow a nearly linear cost, while singleton and two-request batches have distinct positive residuals. Explicit indicators can represent those observed regimes without distorting the empty-queue baseline. Their association with cold execution remains unverified."}
